name: personal-social-inbox
description: Local, read-only aggregation of personal messaging exports for agent search and review-required event monitoring.

interface.shortDescription: Read personal message exports in one local inbox.
interface.longDescription: Imports explicitly selected personal messaging exports into a provenance-preserving local store and exposes read-only source status, conversation, search, context, attachment, digest, and review-required event candidate tools to Codex.
defaultPrompt: Show my most recent imported conversations.
Search my imported messages and include source references.
Check for review-required signup or deadline candidates and show their evidence.
Build an evidence-backed digest of my imported messages.
